Description
 The company is a leading provider of innovative broadband solutions that deliver video, voice and data to communications providers around the world. GlobalLogic team participates in development, QA and support of several generations of these solutions.
The project is about developing the software-based network equipment which provides access to Internet/IPTV/VoIP services using powerful servers.
Application is a tool for networking monitoring. Currently there are no competitors to this project in the world and Customer offers the opportunity to be at the beginning of the rapid development of the product and the opportunity to take their place in a fast-paced engineering team.
 Requirements
 Technical Requirements
4+ years of industry experience building and operating large-scale data platforms
4+ years of hands-on experience with SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and data pipeline development
Proven experience designing and maintaining large-scale data ingestion pipelines (batch and real-time)
Practical experience with orchestration and streaming frameworks such as Airflow, Kafka, Apache NiFi, Spark, Hadoop, Flink
Experience in data modeling, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, and data warehousing concepts
Working knowledge of cloud data platform GCP (AWS, Azure can be as addition)
Practical experience with AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Skills, agent mode, BMAD method)
 Other Requirements:
Advanced English – both verbal and written, comfortable in direct customer-facing interactions
Willingness and ability to travel when needed
Ability to work independently and manage tasks efficiently
Attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving
 Nice to Have:
Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes
Background in streaming architectures and event-driven systems
Familiarity with CI/CD tools and workflows involving Git/GitHub and Jira
Prior experience in a client-facing or consulting capacity
 Job responsibilities
You’ll design and build scalable data ingestion pipelines and infrastructure, collaborating with engineers and analysts to turn business needs into reliable data solutions. Responsibilities include maintaining data quality and reliability, code reviews, and travel to client sites or offices as needed.
We’re looking for someone who can hit the ground running – ask the right questions, push for clarity, and make things happen independently. If you thrive in a fast-moving environment and don’t need hand-holding to deliver, you’ll fit right in.
